glossary.definition: (2) "Violence Against Women Act" means section 1910A of section 40151 of the "Violent Crime Control and Law Enforcement Act of 1994," part A of Title XIX of the "Public Health and Human Services Act," 108 Stat. 1920 (1994), former 42 U.S.C. 300w, 42 U.S.C. 280b-1b, as amended.

glossary.definition: (3) "Breast and Cervical Cancer Mortality Prevention Act" means the "Breast and Cervical Cancer Mortality Prevention Act of 1990," 104 Stat. 409 (1990), 42 U.S.C. 300k, as amended.
glossary.normalized: breast and cervical cancer mortality prevention act

glossary.definition: (4) "Infertility prevention project" means the infertility prevention project operated by the United States centers for disease control and prevention.
glossary.source_title: Section 3701.034 - Restrictions regarding use of certain federal funds.

glossary.definition: (5) "Minority HIV/AIDS initiative" means the minority HIV/AIDS initiative operated by the office of minority health in the United States department of health and human services.
glossary.source_title: Section 3701.034 - Restrictions regarding use of certain federal funds.

glossary.definition: (6) "Personal responsibility education program" means the program administered by the administration for children and families in the United States department of health and human services to educate adolescents on abstinence and contraception for the prevention of pregnancy and sexually transmitted infections.
glossary.source_title: Section 3701.034 - Restrictions regarding use of certain federal funds.

glossary.definition: (7) "Nontherapeutic abortion" has the same meaning as in section 9.04 of the Revised Code.
